description: Read-only season dashboard (static site) plus Python market-data collectors. The only npm dependency is Playwright, used by the source-probing scripts; the dashboard itself ships zero JavaScript dependencies.
name: ticket-desk

scripts.build: python3 scripts/check_privacy.py && python3 scripts/check_readonly.py && mkdir -p dist/data && cp index.html styles.css app.js dist/ && cp data/schedule.json data/outcomes.json dist/data/
